synthesizedFacts.fact: Mineral sunscreens, also known as physical sunscreens, create a barrier on the skin to reflect UV rays and are generally gentler on sensitive skin.
The main issue with mineral sunscreens is that they can leave a white cast, especially on darker skin tones.
Chemical sunscreens absorb into the skin to filter UV rays and are often preferred for their lack of white cast.
Certain ingredients like hyaluronic acid and niacinamide in sunscreens can provide additional skin benefits such as hydration and brightening.
